description: This file defines the class TableFinder with a static method to locate a table within a Rom object by name prefix, throwing exceptions if none or multiple matches are found.

classes.name: TableFinder
classes.description: Utility class providing static method to find a table with a name starting with a specified string within a Rom object.

methods.name: findTableStartsWith
methods.description: Finds and returns a single Table object from a Rom that starts with the specified name, throwing exceptions if none or multiple are found.
